repos.description: :books: Freely available programming books
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是免费编程书籍的权威集合，涵盖多语言、多领域的开源学习资源，支持动态搜索和静态网站访问，由非营利组织 Free Ebook Foundation 维护，是全球最受欢迎的开源项目之一。
repos.summary_en: This repository aggregates freely available programming books across multiple languages and domains, featuring dynamic search and static site access. Maintained by the non-profit Free Ebook Foundation, it is one of GitHub's most popular open-source projects.

repos.description: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
repos.summary_zh: MarkItDown 是一个轻量级 Python 工具，用于将各类文件（如 PDF、Office 文档、图片、音频、HTML 等）转换为结构化的 Markdown 格式，专为 LLM 和文本分析流水线设计。它支持 OCR、语音转文本、ZIP 内文件遍历及 YouTube 链接解析，注重保留文档结构（标题、表格、列表等），输出高度兼容主流大模型。
repos.summary_en: MarkItDown is a lightweight Python utility that converts various file types (PDF, Office docs, images, audio, HTML, etc.) into structured Markdown for use with LLMs and text analysis pipelines. It supports OCR, speech-to-text, ZIP extraction, and YouTube URL conversion, preserving document structure like headings and tables for optimal LLM compatibility.

repos.description: :books: 免费的计算机编程类中文书籍，欢迎投稿
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是免费的中文编程书籍索引库，涵盖操作系统、Web开发、算法、大数据等语言无关和语言相关的计算机技术书籍，提供高质量的学习资源集合，支持社区投稿与更新，助力程序员技能提升。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a curated collection of free Chinese programming books covering computer science fundamentals, web development, algorithms, and major programming languages, serving as a valuable learning resource for developers with community-driven contributions.

repos.description: 所有小初高、大学PDF教材。
repos.summary_zh: 该项目开源了国内小初高及大学PDF教材资源，旨在促进教育公平与普及，消除地区间教育贫困。特别聚焦小学数学和初中数学教材，提供人教版义务教育教科书，支持海外华人子女了解国内教育体系，推动以兴趣为导向的学习。
repos.summary_en: This project provides open access to Chinese K-12 and university PDF textbooks, promoting educational equity and accessibility. It focuses on elementary and middle school math materials, offering People's Education Press editions to support overseas Chinese families and foster interest-driven learning beyond exam-oriented education.

repos.description: Transforms complex documents like PDFs and Office docs into LLM-ready markdown/JSON for your Agentic workflows.
repos.summary_zh: MinerU 是一款高效文档解析工具，可将 PDF 等复杂文档自动转换为 LLM 友好的结构化输出（Markdown/JSON），显著提升 Agentic 工作流的文档处理效率与数据可用性。
repos.summary_en: MinerU is a high-performance document parsing tool that transforms complex documents like PDFs into LLM-ready structured outputs (Markdown/JSON), significantly enhancing document processing efficiency and data accessibility for agentic workflows.

repos.description: Get your documents ready for gen AI
repos.summary_zh: Docling 是一个强大的文档处理工具，支持多种格式（PDF、DOCX、PPTX等）的解析与理解，具备高级 PDF 布局分析、表格识别、OCR 及音频转文本功能。它提供统一的 DoclingDocument 输出格式，支持导出为 Markdown、HTML、JSON 等格式，并无缝集成 LangChain、LlamaIndex 等 AI 框架，专为生成式 AI 应用打造。
repos.summary_en: Docling is a powerful document processing tool that parses diverse formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, etc.) with advanced PDF layout analysis, table recognition, OCR, and ASR capabilities. It outputs unified DoclingDocument format, supports exports to Markdown, HTML, JSON, and integrates seamlessly with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and other AI frameworks for gen AI applications.

repos.description: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates. · by Hugo He
repos.summary_zh: PPT Master 是一款开源 AI 工具，能将任意文档转化为原生可编辑的 PPTX 文件，支持原生形状、动画效果及演讲者备注转语音旁白，并可应用自定义模板。相比生成静态幻灯片图片，它生成真正可编辑的演示文稿，大幅提升内容复用与二次编辑效率，适合教育、汇报、技术分享等场景。
repos.summary_en: PPT Master is an open-source AI tool that converts any document into a natively editable PPTX file, preserving native shapes, animations, and speaker notes with optional audio narration. It supports custom .pptx templates instead of static slide images, enabling full post-generation editing. Ideal for education, presentations, and technical sharing where editable, reusable slide decks are essential.

repos.description: 高性价比人生指南: 长寿防病、急救、省钱理财、法律红线、失业与工伤、医保社保、恋爱婚育、怀孕育儿、创业与做平台合规、出国与技能。每条写明成本、收益、证据等级和原始出处，只引期刊论文与官方文件。
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是一份循证生活指南，收录498条高性价比建议，覆盖健康长寿、急救、理财、法律红线、婚育育儿、创业合规等领域。每条建议明确标注成本、收益、证据等级及原始文献出处，仅引用期刊论文与官方文件，并提供在线检索与筛选功能。
repos.summary_en: An evidence-based life guide with 498 high-cost-performance recommendations covering longevity, first aid, finance, legal risks, marriage & parenting, and entrepreneurship compliance. Each entry specifies cost, benefit, evidence grade and original references from peer-reviewed journals and official documents, with online search and filtering support.

repos.description: Agent skills for Obsidian. Teach your agent to use Obsidian CLI and open formats including Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供专为 Obsidian 设计的 Agent 技能集，支持 Markdown、Bases、JSON Canvas 和 CLI 操作，兼容 Claude Code、Codex 等 Agent 框架，实现知识管理与自动化处理的无缝集成。
repos.summary_en: This repo delivers agent skills for Obsidian, enabling creation and editing of Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas files, and CLI interactions. Fully compatible with Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode via the Agent Skills specification.

repos.description: TensorFlow Tutorial and Examples for Beginners (support TF v1 & v2)
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为 TensorFlow 初学者提供全面且结构化的学习路径，涵盖从基础操作到高级模型的完整示例。通过 Jupyter Notebook 和源码结合的方式，清晰展示 TF v1 与 v2 的实现差异，重点突出现代 API 最佳实践（如 layers、estimator、dataset），适合希望快速上手 TensorFlow 并掌握其核心功能的开发者。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive, beginner-friendly tutorial for TensorFlow, featuring clear examples in both notebooks and source code for TF v1 and v2. It covers fundamental operations to advanced models, emphasizing modern API practices such as layers, estimator, and dataset. Ideal for developers seeking hands-on experience with TensorFlow's core functionalities.

repos.description: 快速、简洁、解决大文件内存溢出的java处理Excel工具
repos.summary_zh: EasyExcel 是阿里巴巴开源的高性能 Java Excel 处理工具，解决传统框架如 Apache POI 在处理大文件时的内存溢出问题。通过重写底层解析逻辑，在仅 16M 内存下 23 秒完成 75M 超大 Excel 文件解析，支持读写、模板导出、极速模式，提供简洁 API 和完整文档，适用于企业级大数据量场景。
repos.summary_en: EasyExcel is a high-performance Java tool for reading and writing Excel files, developed by Alibaba. It addresses memory overflow issues in traditional frameworks like Apache POI by re-engineering the parsing logic. Capable of processing a 75MB Excel file (460K rows) in just 23 seconds using only 16MB RAM, it supports templates, export, and ultra-fast mode, offering a simple API and comprehensive documentation for enterprise-scale data handling.

repos.description: 🃏 A magical documentation site generator.
repos.summary_zh: Docsify 是一个神奇的文档站点生成器，可将 Markdown 文件直接转换为静态网站，无需构建流程。支持全文搜索、多主题切换、插件扩展和 Emoji 渲染，适用于快速搭建技术文档、项目说明等轻量级网站。
repos.summary_en: Docsify is a magical documentation site generator that converts Markdown files into static websites without requiring a build process. It features full-text search, multiple themes, plugin support, and emoji rendering, ideal for rapidly building lightweight technical documentation and project wikis.

repos.description: The open source frontend for GitBook doc sites
repos.summary_zh: GitBook 是一个开源的前端文档渲染引擎，专为技术知识管理而设计。它基于 Next.js 构建，支持本地开发和自定义发布站点，提供团队协作的文档管理功能，适用于开源项目和技术团队的知识共享。
repos.summary_en: GitBook is an open-source frontend engine for rendering GitBook documentation sites, built on Next.js. It enables local development and custom publishing of technical knowledge, supporting team collaboration and open-source contributions for documentation workflows.

repos.description: 互联网首份程序员考公指南，由3位已经进入体制内的前大厂程序员联合献上。
repos.summary_zh: 《程序员考公指南》由三位成功上岸的前大厂程序员联合撰写，总结一年在职备考经验，提供从备考策略、时间管理到岗位选择的系统性指导，帮助程序员转型进入体制内，涵盖公务员、事业编制及教师岗位，强调实用性与可行性。
repos.summary_en: The 'Programmer's Guide to Civil Service Exams' is co-authored by three former tech employees who successfully transitioned into government roles after a year of part-time preparation. It offers practical strategies for programmers considering public sector careers, covering civil service, public institutions, and teaching positions with real-world insights and actionable advice.

repos.description: 面向开发者的 LLM 入门教程，吴恩达大模型系列课程中文版
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是面向开发者的 LLM 入门教程，基于吴恩达大模型系列课程打造，覆盖 Prompt Engineering、RAG、模型微调等全流程。内容涵盖从基础 API 调用到 LangChain 应用开发，提供中文复现代码与 Prompt 优化方案，支持 Jupyter Notebook 实践，助力开发者快速掌握 LLM 应用开发技能。
repos.summary_en: This project is a developer-focused LLM入门教程 based on Andrew Ng's large language model courses, covering Prompt Engineering, RAG, and fine-tuning. It includes translated, reproduced code examples and optimized Chinese prompts, enabling hands-on learning via Jupyter Notebooks to help developers master LLM application development.

repos.description: Convert Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF to clean Markdown. Built in Rust, with Node.js and Python bindings.
repos.summary_zh: anydoc 是基于 Rust 的高性能文档转换库，支持 Word、PDF、Excel 等 8 种格式一键转为 GitHub-Flavored Markdown。提供 Node.js、Python、WebAssembly 多语言绑定，毫秒级响应，专为 LLM 数据预处理和 AI Agent 集成设计，是 Firecrawl Parse 的核心引擎。
repos.summary_en: anydoc is a high-performance Rust library that converts 8+ document formats (Word, PDF, Excel, etc.) into clean GitHub-Flavored Markdown in single-digit milliseconds. Offers Node.js, Python, and WebAssembly bindings, purpose-built for LLM data preprocessing and AI Agent integration, powering Firecrawl Parse.

repos.description: 《李宏毅深度学习教程》（李宏毅老师推荐👍，苹果书🍎），PDF下载地址：https://github.com/datawhalechina/leedl-tutorial/releases
repos.summary_zh: 《李宏毅深度学习教程》是台湾大学李宏毅教授经典课程的中文教程，涵盖深度学习核心理论与前沿技术。教程以幽默易懂的方式讲解复杂概念，结合动画案例与详细公式推导，降低学习门槛。内容源自2021年春课程并扩展2017年春课程及外部知识，适合深度学习初学者系统入门。
repos.summary_en: LeeDL-Tutorial is a comprehensive Chinese guide to deep learning based on Professor Hung-yi Lee's renowned courses. It simplifies complex concepts through engaging examples and detailed derivations, covering core theories and techniques. Expanded from the 2021 Spring course with additional content from 2017 and external resources, it serves as an ideal entry point for beginners in deep learning.

repos.description: A simple, Git-powered wiki with a local frontend and support for many kinds of markup and content.
repos.summary_zh: Gollum 是一个基于 Git 的轻量级 Wiki 系统，支持多种标记语言（如 Markdown、AsciiDoc 等），提供本地前端界面和版本控制功能。它允许用户通过 Git 仓库管理 Wiki 页面，支持实时编辑、历史回溯、数学公式、图表（Mermaid/PlantUML）、BibTeX 引用等高级功能，兼容 GitHub/GitLab Wiki，适合团队协作与知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Gollum is a Git-powered wiki system that enables version-controlled, human-editable text files organized in a Git repository. It supports multiple markup languages, real-time editing, page history, diagrams (Mermaid/PlantUML), math rendering, citations, and integrates seamlessly with GitHub/GitLab wikis for collaborative documentation.

repos.description: 《Python Cookbook》 3rd Edition Translation
repos.summary_zh: 《Python Cookbook》3rd Edition 中文翻译项目，由David Beazley原著，完整覆盖Python 3.6特性，提供100+实用代码示例，涵盖数据结构、并发编程、网络开发等核心领域，是中文开发者掌握Python 3的权威实践指南。
repos.summary_en: This is the Chinese translation of 'Python Cookbook' 3rd Edition by David Beazley, featuring 100+ practical Python 3.6 code examples across core domains like data structures, concurrency, and network programming, serving as an authoritative hands-on guide for Chinese developers mastering Python 3.

repos.description: Not Just A Notepad! (golang + mongodb) http://leanote.org
repos.summary_zh: Leanote 是一款功能强大的开源笔记应用，采用 Go 语言和 MongoDB 构建，提供富文本和 Markdown 编辑器，支持 Vim/Emacs 编辑模式、知识管理、协作分享及博客发布。它弥补了 Evernote 在代码高亮、实时渲染、跨平台支持等方面的不足，适合个人与团队知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Leanote is a powerful open-source note-taking app built with Go and MongoDB, featuring rich-text and Markdown editors, Vim/Emacs modes, knowledge management, collaboration, and blogging. It addresses Evernote's limitations in code syntax highlighting, real-time rendering, and cross-platform support, ideal for personal and team knowledge management.

repos.description: Google 开源项目风格指南 (中文版)
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是 Google 开源项目风格指南的权威中文翻译版，涵盖 C++、Python、Java、JavaScript、TypeScript、Shell、HTML/CSS 等 8 种主流语言的编码规范。内容详尽，提供统一的代码风格指导，提升大型项目协作效率与可维护性。
repos.summary_en: This is the authoritative Chinese translation of Google's open-source style guides, covering coding standards for 8 major languages including C++, Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Shell, and HTML/CSS. It provides comprehensive guidelines to ensure consistency, readability, and maintainability in large-scale software projects.

repos.description: Convert PDF to HTML without losing text or format.
repos.summary_zh: pdf2htmlEX 是一款将 PDF 转换为高质量 HTML 的工具，完美保留原文文本、字体、排版及复杂布局（如数学公式、图表、多栏排版），支持链接、书签、SVG 背景等功能。适用于学术文献、杂志等复杂文档的网页化发布，提供单文件输出或按需加载模式，文件体积通常小于原 PDF。
repos.summary_en: pdf2htmlEX converts PDF files into HTML while preserving text, fonts, layout, and complex elements like formulas and figures. It supports links, bookmarks, SVG backgrounds, and more. Ideal for publishing academic papers and magazines online, offering compact output (often smaller than PDF) with optional on-demand loading via JavaScript.

repos.description: LangChain 的中文入门教程
repos.summary_zh: LangChain 中文入门教程系统讲解大模型应用开发框架，涵盖文档加载、文本分割、向量存储、Chain 链与 Agent 代理等核心概念，提供 OpenAI API 集成、PDF/YouTube 数据处理等实战案例，配套 GitBook 与 Colab 代码，适合 AI 开发者快速上手构建智能应用。
repos.summary_en: This comprehensive LangChain Chinese tutorial covers core concepts like document loading, text splitting, vectorstores, chains, and agents for building LLM-powered applications. It includes practical examples with OpenAI integration, PDF/YouTube data processing, and provides GitBook and Colab code resources for developers to quickly build AI applications.

repos.description: Featuring powerful AI capabilities and supporting various e-book formats, it makes reading smarter and more focused.
repos.summary_zh: Anx Reader 是一款专为书迷打造的智能电子书阅读器，集成强大 AI 功能，支持 EPUB、MOBI、AZW3、FB2、TXT、PDF 等多种格式。提供 AI 摘要、翻译、思维导图生成、多端同步、自定义排版、语音朗读及阅读统计等深度功能，致力于提升阅读效率与沉浸体验。
repos.summary_en: Anx Reader is an AI-powered e-book reader designed for book lovers, supporting multiple formats like EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, TXT, and PDF. It features AI summaries, translation, mind mapping, cross-platform sync, customizable typography, TTS, and reading analytics to enhance focus and reading pleasure.

repos.description: Tabula is a tool for liberating data tables trapped inside PDF files
repos.summary_zh: Tabula 是一款开源工具，专用于从 PDF 文件中提取结构化表格数据，支持 CSV 格式输出。其核心优势在于本地化处理，确保数据安全，仅适用于文本型 PDF（非扫描件）。项目虽非活跃维护，但底层 Java 库 tabula-java 持续更新，适合数据分析师、记者等处理 PDF 表格的场景。
repos.summary_en: Tabula is an open-source tool designed to extract structured table data from PDF files into CSV format. It emphasizes local processing for data security and works only with text-based PDFs (not scanned documents). While the main app is no longer actively maintained, the underlying tabula-java library continues to receive updates, making it suitable for data analysts and journalists handling PDF tables.

repos.description: Claude Skill: Multi-source content processor for NotebookLM. Supports WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, PDF, Markdown, search queries → Podcast/PPT/MindMap/Quiz etc.
repos.summary_zh: qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm 是一个 Claude Code Skill，支持将微信公众号、网页、YouTube、PDF、Markdown 等 15 种以上内容源自动处理并上传至 Google NotebookLM，生成播客、PPT、思维导图、Quiz 等多种输出格式。其核心亮点是内置 6 层付费墙绕过机制，可自动提取 300+ 付费网站内容，结合 AI 实现多模态内容转换。
repos.summary_en: qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm is a Claude Code Skill that processes 15+ content sources—including WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, PDF, and Markdown—and uploads them to Google NotebookLM to generate outputs like podcasts, PPTs, mind maps, and quizzes. Its standout feature is a 6-layer paywall bypass system that automatically extracts content from 300+ premium news sites, enabling AI-powered multimodal content transformation.

repos.description: Python PDF Parser (Not actively maintained). Check out pdfminer.six.
repos.summary_zh: PDFMiner 是一个用于从 PDF 文档中提取文本和布局信息的纯 Python 工具，支持 PDF-1.7 格式及多种字体类型，具备自动排版分析、加密文档处理、CJK 语言支持等功能，可将 PDF 转换为文本、HTML、XML 等格式，并提供命令行工具与调试接口。
repos.summary_en: PDFMiner is a pure Python tool for extracting text and layout information from PDF documents, supporting PDF-1.7, various fonts, encryption, and CJK languages. It enables conversion to text, HTML, XML, and provides detailed layout analysis via command-line tools. Note: This project is no longer actively maintained.

repos.description: Learn python3 in one picture.
repos.summary_zh: 本项目通过一张图片全面展示 Python3 核心语法与特性，涵盖数据类型、流程控制、函数、类、模块等关键内容，辅以 IPython Notebook 交互版本，适合快速入门与参考。
repos.summary_en: This project presents a comprehensive one-page visual guide to Python 3 syntax and features, including data types, control flow, functions, classes, and modules, with an interactive IPython Notebook version for easy learning and reference.

repos.description: A Python implementation of John Gruber’s Markdown with Extension support.
repos.summary_zh: Python-Markdown 是 Python 实现的 John Gruber 官方 Markdown 语法解析器，高度兼容参考实现，支持扩展机制，提供简洁的 API 将 Markdown 文本转换为标准 HTML，广泛用于文档生成、静态站点构建和内容管理系统。
repos.summary_en: Python-Markdown is a Python implementation of John Gruber's Markdown, nearly fully compliant with the reference implementation. It supports extensible syntax via plugins, offering a clean API to convert Markdown text into HTML, widely used in documentation, static site generation, and content management systems.

repos.description: ⚙️ Convert HTML to Markdown. Even works with entire websites and can be extended through rules.
repos.summary_zh: html-to-markdown 是一款强大的 HTML 到 Markdown 转换工具，支持完整网页转换、复杂格式处理、自定义选项和插件扩展。提供 Golang 库、CLI 工具和在线 API 三种使用方式，具备智能转义、表格支持、嵌套列表等高级功能，适用于内容提取、文档转换等场景。
repos.summary_en: html-to-markdown is a robust HTML-to-Markdown converter that transforms entire websites into clean, readable Markdown with support for complex formatting, customizable options, and extensible plugins. It offers a Golang library, CLI tool, and hosted REST API, featuring smart escaping, table conversion, nested lists, and relative-to-absolute link resolution.

repos.description: MarkDown在线简历工具，可在线预览、编辑和生成PDF。[此项目已不再维护，建议使用 cv.ftqq.com 替代 ]
repos.summary_zh: DeerResume 是一款功能强大的 Markdown 在线简历工具，支持实时编辑、预览、密码保护和一键生成 PDF。用户可自主部署，自由定制样式，适用于技术岗位简历制作，尤其适合开发者使用。
repos.summary_en: DeerResume is a powerful Markdown-based online resume tool that supports real-time editing, preview, password protection, and PDF generation. It allows self-hosting with customizable styles, making it ideal for developers creating professional tech resumes.

repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是冬瓜关于 Pi-Agent SDK 的深度学习笔记，系统拆解了生产级 AI Agent 运行时的核心架构。教程涵盖 Agent Loop、工具系统、事件驱动等 10 大模块，通过 TypeScript 与 Python 双语言对照，深入剖析了 Agent SDK 的设计取舍与源码实现，适合希望构建或理解 Agent 底层逻辑的开发者。
repos.summary_en: A deep-dive tutorial repository on the Pi-Agent SDK, systematically deconstructing the core architecture of production-grade AI Agent runtimes. Covering 10 modules including Agent Loop, tool systems, and event-driven design, it provides TypeScript and Python dual-language comparisons to analyze the source code and design trade-offs of Agent SDKs for developers.

repos.description: Document (PDF, Word, PPTX ...) extraction and parse API using state of the art modern OCRs + Ollama supported models. Anonymize documents. Remove PII. Convert any document or picture to structured JSON or Markdown
repos.summary_zh: text-extract-api 是一个本地部署的文档提取与解析 API，支持 PDF、Word、PPT 和图片转换为高精度 Markdown 或结构化 JSON，集成 EasyOCR、Llama3.2-vision 等先进 OCR 模型及 Ollama 大模型，具备 PII 匿名化、分布式 Celery 队列处理、Redis 缓存等功能，无需依赖云端服务。
repos.summary_en: text-extract-api is a locally deployed document extraction and parsing API that converts images, PDFs, and Office documents into high-accuracy Markdown or structured JSON using advanced OCRs like EasyOCR and Llama3.2-vision, integrated with Ollama LLMs for text refinement and PII removal. It features distributed Celery processing, Redis caching, and no external cloud dependencies.

repos.description: markdown2: A fast and complete implementation of Markdown in Python
repos.summary_zh: markdown2 是一个高性能、完整的 Python Markdown 解析器，严格遵循原始 Perl 实现的行为。支持丰富的扩展语法（如代码高亮、表格、脚注等），兼容 Python 3.5+，提供模块和命令行两种使用方式，适合快速将 Markdown 转换为结构化的 HTML。
repos.summary_en: markdown2 is a fast, complete Python implementation of Markdown that closely matches the original Perl version. It supports numerous extras like syntax highlighting, tables, and footnotes, works with Python 3.5+, and offers both module and CLI usage for converting Markdown to HTML.

repos.description: A better file browser and calendar inspired by Apple Notes, Bear, Evernote and Day One.
repos.summary_zh: Notebook Navigator 是 Obsidian 的一款插件，用简洁的双窗格界面替代默认文件浏览器，支持文件夹树、标签浏览、文件预览、键盘导航、拖拽操作、固定笔记及高度可定制化显示选项，显著提升笔记管理效率。
repos.summary_en: Notebook Navigator is an Obsidian plugin that replaces the default file explorer with a clean two-pane interface, offering folder tree navigation, tag browsing, file previews, keyboard shortcuts, drag-and-drop, pinned notes, and customizable display options for efficient note management.

repos.description: 一键将视频转换为优质小红书笔记，自动优化内容和配图
repos.summary_zh: 视频笔记生成器一键将视频内容转换为优质小红书笔记，支持自动语音转文字、AI内容优化、标题创作、配图获取及标签生成。V2.0版本采用FastAPI提供现代化Web界面，支持批量处理、长视频解析、智能错误重试与历史记录管理，显著提升内容创作效率。
repos.summary_en: Video Note Generator automatically converts videos into high-quality Xiaohongshu notes with speech-to-text, AI content optimization, title generation, image fetching, and hashtag creation. V2.0 features a modern FastAPI web interface, batch processing, 30-minute video support, smart retry mechanisms, and history tracking for efficient content production.

repos.description: 租房要点，适用于北上广深杭，欢迎补充。
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库整理了中国一线城市（北上广深杭）租房核心要点，聚焦避坑指南与实操策略，涵盖直租识别、中介甄别、合同陷阱防范及合租注意事项，强调实地验房与房东资质核查，旨在帮助租客规避常见纠纷、保障居住安全与权益。
repos.summary_en: This repository compiles essential rental tips for major Chinese cities (Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Hangzhou), focusing on avoiding pitfalls and practical strategies. It covers identifying direct landlord rentals, vetting agents, contract traps, and co-living safety, emphasizing on-site inspections and landlord qualification checks to protect tenants from disputes and unsafe housing.

repos.description: pip install python-office 自动化办公专用库
repos.summary_zh: python-office 是一个专为自动化办公设计的 Python 第三方库，支持一键安装所有功能模块。用户仅需一行代码即可实现微信机器人、PDF处理、邮件发送、Excel/Word/PowerPoint 操作、OCR 识别、AI 工具调用等办公场景需求，无需掌握 Python 编程即可快速上手，显著提升办公效率。
repos.summary_en: python-office is a Python third-party library designed for office automation, enabling one-line code solutions for tasks like WeChat bots, PDF processing, email sending, Excel/Word/PowerPoint operations, OCR, and AI tools. It requires no Python knowledge, supports modular imports, and significantly boosts productivity with zero learning curve.

repos.description: 文档（小说、论文、字幕）翻译工具（支持 pdf/word/excel/json/epub/srt...）Document (Novel, Thesis, Subtitle) Translation Tool (Supports pdf/word/excel/json/epub/srt...)
repos.summary_zh: DocuTranslate 是一款基于大语言模型的本地文档翻译工具，支持 PDF、Word、Excel、JSON、EPUB、SRT 等多种格式。具备自动术语表生成、PDF 表格/公式/代码识别、JSON 路径翻译、格式保留、多 AI 平台支持、异步高并发处理、局域网多用户共享及交互式 Web 界面等功能。提供便携版安装包，适合小说、论文、字幕等场景的批量翻译。
repos.summary_en: DocuTranslate is a lightweight local document translation tool powered by Large Language Models. It supports multiple formats including PDF, Word, Excel, JSON, EPUB, and SRT. Features include automatic glossary generation, PDF table/formula/code recognition, JSON path-based translation, format preservation, multi-AI platform support, async concurrency, LAN multi-user access, and an integrated Web UI. Ideal for translating novels, academic papers, and subtitles with portable installers under 40MB.

repos.description: 一款基于 AI 技术的 Web 应用程序，可将文本内容智能转换为 Mermaid 格式的代码，并将其渲染成可视化图表。
repos.summary_zh: Smart Mermaid 是一款基于 AI 的 Web 应用，可将自然语言文本智能转换为 Mermaid 图表代码并实时渲染。支持流程图、序列图等多种图表类型，提供标准 SVG 与手绘风格双渲染器，具备 AI 代码修复、优化及文件导入功能，适合快速生成可视化图表。
repos.summary_en: Smart Mermaid is an AI-powered web app that converts natural language text into Mermaid diagram code and renders it visually. It supports multiple chart types, dual rendering modes (SVG and hand-drawn), AI-assisted code fixing/optimization, and file import, enabling efficient text-to-diagram conversion for technical documentation and planning.

repos.description: 基于@a937750307 项目lan-printing的修改
repos.summary_zh: 基于原项目的改进版内网打印解决方案，支持多种Office文档与图片格式自动转换为PDF，通过Web界面实现跨设备打印。内置文件拖拽上传、PDF预览与管理功能，适用于无法直连打印机时的远程打印需求。
repos.summary_en: An improved intranet printing solution supporting automatic conversion of Office documents and images to PDF. Features a web interface for cross-device printing, drag-and-drop upload, PDF preview and file management. Ideal for remote printing scenarios where direct printer connection is unavailable.

repos.description: 微信公众号文章抓取 & Markdown 转换工具
repos.summary_zh: 该工具利用 Camoufox 实现反检测抓取，自动提取微信公众号文章的标题、账号、发布时间及原文链接，并将 HTML 内容转换为结构清晰的 Markdown 格式，同时下载图片至本地并重写链接，支持代码块语法高亮，适用于内容归档与知识管理。
repos.summary_en: This tool uses Camoufox for anti-detection fetching to extract WeChat Official Account articles, converting HTML content into clean Markdown with metadata (title, account, publish time, URL), downloading images locally, and preserving code blocks with language syntax. Ideal for content archiving and knowledge management.

repos.description: An open-source presentation theme ecosystem for Marp/Markdown users.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Marp 是一个基于 Markdown 的演示文稿工具，提供 38 种自定义 CSS 样式和 6 种主题，支持分栏布局、导航进度、封面页、目录页及定理框等，可替代 LaTeX Beamer。配套 VS Code 和 Obsidian，支持字体自定义，适合高效制作美观幻灯片。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Marp is a Markdown-based presentation tool offering 38 custom CSS styles and 6 themes, supporting multi-column layouts, navigation progress bars, cover pages, table of contents, and callout boxes. It replaces LaTeX Beamer with enhanced styling, integrates with VS Code and Obsidian, and allows font customization for professional slides.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目将《数理化自学丛书》17册扫描PDF重建为语义化Markdown与可复现EPUB3电子书，保留全部4,875幅插图与88,653个MathML公式。提供完整构建工具链、来源审计与隐私门禁，适用于文献保存、校勘与个人研究场景。
repos.summary_en: Rebuilds the 17-volume Self-Study Series of Math, Physics & Chemistry from scanned PDFs into semantic Markdown and reproducible EPUB3 ebooks, preserving 4,875 illustrations and 88,653 MathML formulas. Provides full build toolchain, provenance auditing, and privacy gates for archival and research use.

repos.summary_zh: Web Content Fetcher 是一个轻量级网页正文提取工具，支持自动将任意网页转换为标准 Markdown 格式。采用 Scrapling 优先策略（fast/stealth 双模式自动降级），并集成 Jina Reader 作为备选方案，完美适配微信公众号、掘金、CSDN 等国内主流平台及海外技术站点。
repos.summary_en: Web Content Fetcher is a lightweight tool for extracting clean Markdown content from web pages. It prioritizes Scrapling with fast/stealth dual-mode auto-fallback, integrates Jina Reader as backup, and supports major Chinese platforms like WeChat Official Accounts, Juejin, and CSDN, plus global tech sites.

repos.description: AngularJS入门教程——AngularJS中文社区提供
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供完整的AngularJS入门教程，涵盖快速开始、模板系统、双向绑定、路由、REST服务等核心功能。由AngularJS中文社区维护，包含15个循序渐进的实践章节，适合前端开发者系统学习AngularJS框架。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive AngularJS tutorial covering core features like templates, two-way binding, routing, and REST services. Maintained by the AngularJS Chinese Community, it includes 15 progressive chapters ideal for developers learning the framework.

repos.description: WeSight Obsidian plugin for local agent runtimes.
repos.summary_zh: WeSight Obsidian 插件将 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等本地 AI 代理集成至 Obsidian 笔记系统，提供侧边栏聊天、内联编辑、文件引用与斜杠命令等功能。支持互联网快照分享、飞书文档同步及微信公众号草稿发布，实现 AI 协作与多平台内容分发的无缝衔接。
repos.summary_en: WeSight Obsidian plugin integrates local AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode directly into your Obsidian vault. Features include sidebar chat, inline editing, file mentions, and slash commands. It supports internet snapshot sharing, Feishu document sync, and WeChat Official Account draft publishing, enabling seamless AI collaboration and multi-platform content distribution.

repos.description: A Python binding for Hoedown.
repos.summary_zh: Misaka 是一个已停止维护的 Python 绑定库，用于 Hoedown 的 Markdown 解析器。它提供高性能的 Markdown 转 HTML 功能，适用于需要轻量级、快速解析的场景。尽管项目不再更新，仍可作为历史参考或特定环境下的替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Misaka is a discontinued Python binding for the Hoedown Markdown parser, offering fast and lightweight Markdown-to-HTML conversion. Though no longer maintained, it remains a historical reference or alternative for specific use cases where performance is critical.

repos.description: A django app that provides Markdown-related template tags using the python-markdown2 library.
repos.summary_zh: django-markdown-deux 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，基于 python-markdown2 库提供 Markdown 模板标签支持。它允许在 Django 模板中通过 `markdown` 过滤器或块标签渲染 Markdown 内容，并支持自定义样式配置，适用于需要统一 Markdown 渲染选项的场景。
repos.summary_en: django-markdown-deux is a lightweight Django app that provides Markdown template tags using the python-markdown2 library. It enables rendering Markdown in Django templates via the `markdown` filter or block tag, with support for customizable styles via configuration, ideal for consistent Markdown processing across templates.

repos.description: Pure-Python PDF Library; this repository is no longer maintained, please see https://github.com/knowah/PyPDF2/ insead.
repos.summary_zh: pyPdf 是一个纯 Python 编写的 PDF 处理库，支持 PDF 文档的读取、写入、页面旋转、水印合并和裁剪等操作，适用于文档自动化处理场景。尽管项目已停止维护，其核心功能仍可用于基础 PDF 操作。
repos.summary_en: pyPdf is a pure-Python library for reading, writing, and manipulating PDF files, supporting operations like page rotation, watermarking, and cropping. Though unmaintained, it remains useful for basic PDF automation tasks.

repos.description: 一个将本地markdown在尽可能保持格式的情况下复制到公众号、知乎、飞书、X等平台的浏览器插件
repos.summary_zh: Markdown Paste Helper 是一款浏览器插件，可将本地 Markdown 内容一键粘贴至知乎、微信公众号、飞书、X Articles 等主流平台，自动转换为适配的富文本格式。支持预处理语法（如 GitHub alerts、任务列表）、自定义公众号主题色与代码高亮，并提供一键分发功能，实现‘一次编写，多端发布’的高效内容创作体验。
repos.summary_en: Markdown Paste Helper is a browser extension that enables one-click pasting of Markdown content into major platforms like Zhihu, WeChat Official Accounts, Feishu, and X Articles, automatically converting it to platform-specific rich text formats. It supports preprocessing syntax (e.g., GitHub alerts, task lists), custom WeChat themes with code highlighting, and offers batch distribution across logged-in platforms for efficient multi-platform publishing.

repos.description: Markdown  在线阅读器
repos.summary_zh: 在线 Markdown 阅读器支持代码高亮、目录自动生成、本地图片显示及导出 HTML，并集成 Todo 列表、MathJax 公式、时序图、Emoji 和 ECharts 图表等扩展语法，提供丰富的富文本阅读体验。
repos.summary_en: An online Markdown reader featuring code highlighting, auto-generated table of contents, local image support, HTML export, and rich extensions including Todo lists, MathJax, sequence diagrams, Emoji, and ECharts visualizations.

repos.description: ⚡ Excel Plugin Framework | Excel插件框架 - C# .NET hot-reload template for VSTO add-ins. Features: WPF/WinForms UI, auto-update, COM safety, MVVM pattern. Perfect for Office automation & Excel/WPS plugins
repos.summary_zh: BasePlugin 是一个基于 DTI_Tool.AddIn 热插拔框架的 Excel 插件开发模板，专为 C#/.NET Framework 构建 VSTO 插件而设计。支持 WPF/WinForms UI、MVVM 模式、自动更新、COM 安全交互，适用于 Excel/WPS 自动化扩展开发。
repos.summary_en: BasePlugin is a comprehensive Excel add-in development template built on the DTI_Tool.AddIn hot-pluggable framework, enabling C#/.NET Framework VSTO plugin development with WPF/WinForms UI, MVVM pattern, auto-update, and COM-safe Excel interop for Office automation.

repos.description: Self-hostable NGINX module that serves Markdown to AI agents via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown), powered by a Rust converter.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个自托管的 NGINX 模块，通过 HTTP 内容协商（Accept: text/markdown）将 HTML 页面转换为 Markdown 格式供 AI 智能体读取。基于 Rust 构建，无需修改现有应用即可为浏览器返回原始 HTML，同时为支持 Markdown 的请求提供纯净内容，降低 AI 处理成本。
repos.summary_en: This project is a self-hostable NGINX module that converts HTML to Markdown via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown) for AI agents, powered by a Rust converter. It serves clean Markdown only when requested while preserving original HTML for browsers, enabling seamless agent-friendly content delivery without application changes.
